summary_en: 4,823,900 shares to be cancelled effective 16 June 2026. Post-cancellation issued shares outstanding (including treasury): 98,944,242. Cancellation represents 4.6% of pre-cancellation issued shares.
title_en: Notice regarding determination of scheduled date for cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: ADEKA Corporation announced the scheduled cancellation date for treasury shares previously disclosed on 8 August 2025. The company will cancel 4,823,900 ordinary shares on 16 June 2026, representing 4.6% of issued shares outstanding before cancellation. The post-cancellation issued share count (including any remaining treasury shares) will be 98,944,242 shares. The notice sets a specific execution date for a cancellation programme already approved and previously announced with an approximate timing window of "early June 2026".
